notes: Hourly surface observations (ASOS / LCD style, routine reports at :53 past the hour, extra reports every 20 minutes while the hurricane is close) for every weather station in sensor_registry.json, standard meteorological records for the two NDBC buoys, and the hurricane advisory series with best track. All times UTC. Stations stop reporting when they lose power or instruments and resume later; missing rows are real gaps, not zeros.

field_notes.WindDir_deg: direction the wind blows from, nearest 10 degrees; 0 with speed 0 is calm
field_notes.Precip1hr_mm: accumulation since the last routine report
field_notes.Remarks: PK WND dddfff = peak wind direction and speed in knots

field_notes.MWD_degT: direction the dominant waves come from

files.content: advisories[] (advisory_number, advisory_type, issued_utc, issued_local, classification, saffir_simpson_category, center, max_sustained_winds_kt, min_central_pressure_mb, movement, headline, watches_and_warnings[], forecast[] with cone_radius_nm, corpus_christi_in_forecast_cone, landfall) and best_track[] (6-hourly position, wind, pressure, status)
